alt: Muscles of the leg that move the foot and toes (OpenStax) - anterior + lateral + posterior compartments.
caption: Leg muscles that move the foot + toes (OpenStax). Anterior compartment (dorsiflexors, deep fibular nerve). Lateral (everters, superficial fibular). Posterior superficial (gastrocnemius, soleus) + deep (tibialis posterior, FHL, FDL - tibial nerve).
